verses.text: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel (advice) of the ungodly. He does not stand in the way of sinners. He does not sit in the seat of the scornful (mockers).
But the blessed man's delight is in the law of the LORD. The man meditates (thinks deeply) on the LORD's law day and night.
The man will be like a tree planted by the rivers of water. The tree brings forth (produces) its fruit in its season. Its leaf will not wither (dry up). Whatever the man does will prosper.
The ungodly are not like this. They are like the chaff (husks) that the wind drives away.
So the ungodly will not stand in the judgment. Sinners will not stand in the congregation (gathering) of the righteous (people right with God).
For the LORD knows the way of the righteous (people right with God). But the way of the ungodly will perish (be destroyed).

verses.text: Why do the heathen (people who are not Jews) rage? Why do the people imagine (plan) a vain (empty) thing?
The kings of the earth set themselves against the LORD. The rulers take counsel (make plans) together against the LORD and against His Anointed (His chosen King). They say:
Let us break their bands (chains) apart. Let us throw away their cords (ropes) from us.
He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision (laugh at them).
Then He will speak to them in His wrath (God's anger). He will vex (terrify) them in His sore (great) displeasure.
Yet I have set My King on My holy hill of Zion.
I will declare (tell) the decree (the LORD's command). The LORD has said to Me: You are My Son. This day I have begotten (become the Father of) You.
Ask of Me, and I will give You the heathen (people who are not Jews) for Your inheritance (what You will own). I will give You the uttermost (farthest) parts of the earth for Your possession.
You will break them with a rod of iron. You will dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel (clay pot).
So be wise now, O you kings. Be instructed (learn), you judges of the earth.
Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

Kiss the Son, or the Son will be angry, and you will perish (be destroyed) from the way. The Son's wrath (God's anger) can be kindled (start to burn) in just a little time. Blessed are all who put their trust in Him.

verses.text: LORD, the people who trouble me have increased so much. Many rise up against me.
Many say about my soul: There is no help for him in God. Selah (pause and think).
But You, O LORD, are a shield for me. You are my glory, and the One who lifts up my head.
I cried to the LORD with my voice. The LORD heard me out of His holy hill. Selah (pause and think).
I lay down and slept. I woke up, for the LORD sustained (held up) me.
I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people who have set themselves against me all around.
Arise, O LORD. Save me, O my God. For You have smitten (struck) all my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the ungodly.
Salvation belongs to the LORD. Your blessing is on Your people. Selah (pause and think).

verses.text: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness (being right with God). You have enlarged (given room to) me when I was in trouble. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
O you sons of men (people), how long will you turn my glory into shame? How long will you love vanity (emptiness), and seek after leasing (lies)? Selah (pause and think).
But know that the LORD has set apart the one who is godly for Himself. The LORD will hear when I call to Him.
Stand in awe, and do not sin. Commune (talk) with your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah (pause and think).
Offer the sacrifices of righteousness (being right with God), and put your trust in the LORD.
There are many who say: Who will show us any good? LORD, lift up the light of Your countenance (face) on us.
You have put gladness (joy) in my heart, more than in the time when their corn (grain) and their wine increased.
I will both lay down in peace and sleep. For You alone, LORD, make me dwell (live) in safety.

verses.text: Give ear to my words, O LORD. Consider my meditation (deep thoughts).
Hearken (listen) to the voice of my cry, my King and my God. For I will pray to You.
You will hear my voice in the morning, O LORD. In the morning I will direct my prayer to You, and I will look up.
For You are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil will not dwell (live) with You.
The foolish will not stand in Your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity (sin).
You will destroy those who speak leasing (lies). The LORD will abhor (hate) the bloody and deceitful (lying) man.
But as for me, I will come into Your house in the multitude (greatness) of Your mercy. In Your fear I will worship toward Your holy temple.
Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness (right ways) because of my enemies. Make Your way straight before my face.
For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their inward part (heart) is very wickedness. Their throat is an open sepulchre (tomb). They flatter (say false, sweet words) with their tongue.
Destroy them, O God. Let them fall by their own counsels (plans). Cast them out because of their many transgressions (sins), for they have rebelled against You.
But let all those who put their trust in You rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because You defend them. Let those who love Your name also be joyful in You.
For You, LORD, will bless the righteous (people right with God). You will compass (surround) the righteous with favor as with a shield.

verses.text: O LORD, do not rebuke (scold) me in Your anger. Do not chasten (correct) me in Your hot displeasure.
Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I am weak. O LORD, heal me, for my bones are vexed (troubled).
My soul is also sore vexed (badly troubled). But You, O LORD, how long?
Return, O LORD, deliver (rescue) my soul. Oh save me for the sake of Your mercies.
For in death there is no remembrance of You. In the grave, who will give You thanks?
I am weary (tired) with my groaning. All night I make my bed swim. I water my couch with my tears.
My eye is consumed (worn out) because of grief. It waxes old (grows weak) because of all my enemies.
Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity (sin). For the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.
The LORD has heard my supplication (begging prayer). The LORD will receive my prayer.
Let all my enemies be ashamed and sore vexed (badly troubled). Let them turn back and be ashamed suddenly.

verses.text: O LORD my God, I put my trust in You. Save me from all those who persecute (attack) me, and deliver (rescue) me.
Or the enemy will tear my soul like a lion. He will rip it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver (rescue) me.
O LORD my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity (sin) in my hands,
If I have paid back evil to the one who was at peace with me (yes, I have even delivered the one who is my enemy without cause),
Then let the enemy persecute (attack) my soul and take it. Yes, let the enemy tread down my life on the earth, and lay my honor in the dust. Selah (pause and think).
Arise, O LORD, in Your anger. Lift Yourself up because of the rage of my enemies. Awake for me to the judgment that You have commanded.
So the congregation (gathering) of the people will compass (surround) You. For their sakes, return on high.
The LORD will judge the people. Judge me, O LORD, by my righteousness (being right with God), and by the integrity (honesty) that is in me.
Oh, let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end. But establish (make firm) the just (those who are right with God). For the righteous God tries (tests) the hearts and reins (deepest feelings).
My defense is of God, who saves the upright (honest) in heart.
God judges the righteous (people right with God), and God is angry with the wicked every day.
If the wicked man does not turn, God will whet (sharpen) His sword. God has bent His bow and made it ready.
God has also prepared for the wicked man the instruments (weapons) of death. God ordains (aims) His arrows against the persecutors (attackers).
Behold (look), the wicked man travails (labors to give birth) with iniquity (sin). He has conceived (become pregnant with) mischief (trouble), and brought forth (given birth to) falsehood (lies).
The wicked man made a pit and dug it. And he has fallen into the ditch which he made.
His mischief (trouble) will return on his own head. His violent dealing will come down on his own pate (top of the head).
I will praise the LORD for His righteousness (right ways). I will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

verses.text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent (great) is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.

Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings (babies who still nurse) You have ordained (set up) strength because of Your enemies, so You might still (silence) the enemy and the avenger (one who pays back).
When I consider Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have ordained (set in place),
What is man, that You are mindful of (think about) him? And the son of man, that You visit (care for) him?
For You have made him a little lower than the angels, and have crowned him with glory and honor.
You made him to have dominion (rule) over the works of Your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
All sheep and oxen, yes, and the beasts of the field,
The fowl (birds) of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
O LORD our Lord, how excellent (great) is Your name in all the earth!

verses.text: I will praise You, O LORD, with my whole heart. I will show all Your marvelous (wonderful) works.
I will be glad and rejoice in You. I will sing praise to Your name, O You most High.
When my enemies are turned back, they will fall and perish (be destroyed) at Your presence.
For You have maintained (defended) my right and my cause. You sat on the throne judging right.
You have rebuked (scolded) the heathen (people who are not Jews). You have destroyed the wicked. You have put out their name forever and ever.
O you enemy, destructions have come to a perpetual (never-ending) end. You have destroyed cities. Their memorial (memory) has perished with them.
But the LORD will endure (last) forever. He has prepared His throne for judgment.
He will judge the world in righteousness (what is right). He will minister (give) judgment to the people in uprightness (fairness).
The LORD also will be a refuge (safe place) for the oppressed (crushed), a refuge (safe place) in times of trouble.
Those who know Your name will put their trust in You. For You, LORD, have not forsaken (left) those who seek You.
Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells (lives) in Zion. Declare (tell) His doings among the people.
When He makes inquisition (searches out the guilt) for blood, He remembers them. He does not forget the cry of the humble.
Have mercy on me, O LORD. Consider my trouble which I suffer from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death,
So that I may show all Your praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will rejoice in Your salvation.
The heathen (people who are not Jews) have sunk down in the pit that they made. Their own foot is caught in the net which they hid.
The LORD is known by the judgment which He carries out. The wicked man is snared (trapped) in the work of his own hands. Higgaion (think deeply). Selah (pause and think).
The wicked will be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
For the needy will not always be forgotten. The expectation (hope) of the poor will not perish (be lost) forever.
Arise, O LORD. Do not let man prevail (win). Let the heathen (people who are not Jews) be judged in Your sight.
Put them in fear, O LORD, so the nations may know they are only men. Selah (pause and think).

verses.text: Why do You stand far off, O LORD? Why do You hide Yourself in times of trouble?
The wicked man in his pride persecutes (attacks) the poor. Let them be caught in the devices (tricks) that they have imagined (planned).
For the wicked man boasts (brags) of his heart's desire. He blesses the covetous (greedy), whom the LORD abhors (hates).
The wicked man, through the pride of his countenance (face), will not seek after God. God is not in any of his thoughts.
His ways are always grievous (hurtful). Your judgments are far above, out of his sight. As for all his enemies, he puffs (sneers) at them.
He has said in his heart: I will not be moved. For I will never be in adversity (trouble).
His mouth is full of cursing and deceit (lies) and fraud (cheating). Under his tongue is mischief (trouble) and vanity (emptiness).
He sits in the lurking (hiding) places of the villages. In the secret places he murders the innocent. His eyes are privily (secretly) set against the poor.
He lies in wait secretly like a lion in his den. He lies in wait to catch the poor. He catches the poor man when he draws him into his net.
He crouches and humbles (lowers) himself, so the poor may fall by his strong ones.
He has said in his heart: God has forgotten. God hides His face. God will never see it.
Arise, O LORD. O God, lift up Your hand. Do not forget the humble.
Why does the wicked man contemn (look down on) God? He has said in his heart: You will not require (punish) it.

You have seen it. For You behold (see) mischief (trouble) and spite (hate), to requite (pay back) it with Your hand. The poor man commits (trusts) himself to You. You are the helper of the fatherless.
Break the arm of the wicked and the evil man. Seek out his wickedness until You find none.
The LORD is King forever and ever. The heathen (people who are not Jews) have perished out of His land.
LORD, You have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause Your ear to hear,
To judge the fatherless and the oppressed (crushed), so that the man of the earth may oppress (crush) no more.

verses.text: I put my trust in the LORD. How can you say to my soul: Flee (run away) like a bird to your mountain?
For look, the wicked bend their bow. They make their arrow ready on the string, so they may privily (secretly) shoot at the upright (honest) in heart.
If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous (people right with God) do?
The LORD is in His holy temple. The LORD's throne is in heaven. His eyes behold (see), His eyelids try (test), the children of men (people).
The LORD tries (tests) the righteous (people right with God). But His soul hates the wicked and the one who loves violence.
On the wicked He will rain snares (traps), fire and brimstone (burning sulfur), and a horrible tempest (storm). This will be the portion (share) of their cup.
For the righteous LORD loves righteousness (what is right). His countenance (face) beholds (sees) the upright (honest).

The LORD will cut off all flattering (falsely sweet) lips, and the tongue that speaks proud things,
Who have said: With our tongue we will prevail (win). Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?
Because of the oppression (crushing) of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, now I will arise, says the LORD. I will set him in safety from the one who puffs (sneers) at him.
The words of the LORD are pure words, like silver tried (tested) in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

Consider and hear me, O LORD my God. Lighten (give light to) my eyes, or I will sleep the sleep of death.
Or my enemy will say: I have prevailed (won) against him. And those who trouble me will rejoice when I am moved.

verses.text: The fool has said in his heart: There is no God. They are corrupt (rotten). They have done abominable (hateful) works. There is no one who does good.
The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men (people), to see if there were any who understood and sought God.
They have all gone aside. They have all together become filthy. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
Do all the workers of iniquity (sin) have no knowledge? They eat up My people as they eat bread, and they do not call on the LORD.
There they were in great fear. For God is in the generation (family) of the righteous (people right with God).
You have shamed the counsel (plans) of the poor man, because the LORD is his refuge (safe place).

verses.text: LORD, who will abide (stay) in Your tabernacle (tent)? Who will dwell (live) on Your holy hill?
The one who walks uprightly (honestly), and works righteousness (what is right), and speaks the truth in his heart.
The one who does not backbite (speak evil of others) with his tongue, does not do evil to his neighbor, and does not take up a reproach (insult) against his neighbor.
In his eyes a vile (evil) person is contemned (looked down on). But he honors those who fear the LORD. He swears (makes a promise) to his own hurt, and does not change.
He does not put out his money to usury (interest), and does not take a reward (bribe) against the innocent. The one who does these things will never be moved.

verses.text: Preserve (keep safe) me, O God, for I put my trust in You.
O my soul, you have said to the LORD: You are my Lord. My goodness does not reach to You,
But to the saints (holy people) who are in the earth, and to the excellent (noble), in whom is all my delight.
The sorrows of those who hurry after another god will be multiplied (made many). I will not offer their drink offerings of blood, or take up their names into my lips.
The LORD is the portion (share) of my inheritance (what I receive) and of my cup. You maintain (keep safe) my lot (my share).
The lines (borders of my land) have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a goodly (good) heritage (what is handed down to me).
I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel (advice). My reins (deepest feelings) also instruct (teach) me in the night seasons.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be moved.
So my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices. My flesh (body) also will rest in hope.
For You will not leave my soul in hell. You will not suffer (allow) Your Holy One to see corruption (decay).
You will show me the path of life. In Your presence is fullness of joy. At Your right hand there are pleasures forevermore.

verses.text: Hear the right, O LORD. Attend (pay attention) to my cry. Give ear to my prayer, which does not go out of feigned (lying) lips.
Let my sentence (judgment) come out from Your presence. Let Your eyes behold (see) the things that are equal (fair).
You have proved (tested) my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried (tested) me, and You will find nothing. I have purposed (decided) that my mouth will not transgress (sin).
Concerning the works of men, by the word of Your lips I have kept myself from the paths of the destroyer.
Hold up my goings (steps) in Your paths, so my footsteps do not slip.
I have called on You, for You will hear me, O God. Incline (bend) Your ear to me, and hear my speech.
Show Your marvelous lovingkindness (wonderful love and kindness), O You who save by Your right hand those who put their trust in You, from those who rise up against them.
Keep me as the apple (pupil) of the eye. Hide me under the shadow of Your wings,
From the wicked who oppress (crush) me, from my deadly enemies, who compass (surround) me.
They are inclosed (shut up) in their own fat. With their mouth they speak proudly.
They have now compassed (surrounded) us in our steps. They have set their eyes bowing down to the earth,
Like a lion that is greedy for his prey, and like a young lion lurking (hiding) in secret places.
Arise, O LORD, disappoint (meet head-on) the wicked man. Cast him down. Deliver (rescue) my soul from the wicked, who is Your sword,

From men who are Your hand, O LORD, from men of the world, who have their portion (share) in this life, and whose belly You fill with Your hidden treasure. They are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance (wealth) to their babes.
As for me, I will behold (see) Your face in righteousness (being right with God). I will be satisfied, when I awake, with Your likeness.

verses.text: I will love You, O LORD, my strength.
The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer (rescuer). He is my God, my strength, in whom I will trust. He is my buckler (shield), and the horn (power) of my salvation, and my high tower.
I will call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised. So I will be saved from my enemies.
The sorrows of death compassed (surrounded) me. The floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
The sorrows of hell compassed (surrounded) me. The snares (traps) of death prevented (came before) me.
In my trouble I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of His temple. My cry came before Him, even into His ears.
Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of the hills also moved and were shaken, because He was wroth (very angry).
Smoke went up out of His nostrils, and fire out of His mouth devoured (burned up). Coals were kindled (set on fire) by it.
He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Darkness was under His feet.
He rode on a cherub (a heavenly creature), and flew. Yes, He flew on the wings of the wind.
He made darkness His secret place. His pavilion (tent) all around Him was dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
At the brightness that was before Him, His thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave His voice: hail stones and coals of fire.
Yes, He sent out His arrows, and scattered them. He shot out lightnings, and discomfited (threw into confusion) them.
Then the channels of waters were seen. The foundations of the world were discovered (uncovered) at Your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
He sent from above. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
He delivered (rescued) me from my strong enemy, and from those who hated me, for they were too strong for me.
They prevented (came against) me in the day of my calamity (disaster). But the LORD was my stay (support).
He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered (rescued) me, because He delighted in me.
The LORD rewarded me by my righteousness (doing right). He has recompensed (paid back) me by the cleanness of my hands.
For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
For all His judgments were before me. I did not put away His statutes (laws) from me.
I was also upright (honest) before Him, and I kept myself from my iniquity (sin).
So the LORD has recompensed (paid back) me by my righteousness (doing right), by the cleanness of my hands in His eyesight.
With the merciful You will show Yourself merciful. With an upright (honest) man You will show Yourself upright (honest).
With the pure You will show Yourself pure. And with the froward (twisted) You will show Yourself froward (opposed to them).
For You will save the afflicted (suffering) people. But You will bring down high looks (proud eyes).
For You will light my candle (lamp). The LORD my God will enlighten (light up) my darkness.
For by You I have run through a troop (band of soldiers). By my God I have leaped over a wall.
As for God, His way is perfect. The word of the LORD is tried (tested and proven). He is a buckler (shield) to all those who trust in Him.
For who is God except the LORD? Or who is a rock except our God?
It is God who girds (wraps) me with strength, and makes my way perfect.
He makes my feet like hinds' feet (the feet of deer), and sets me on my high places.
He teaches my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by my arms.
You have also given me the shield of Your salvation. Your right hand has held me up, and Your gentleness has made me great.
You have enlarged (made wide) my steps under me, so that my feet did not slip.
I have pursued (chased) my enemies, and overtaken (caught) them. I did not turn back until they were consumed (destroyed).
I have wounded them so they were not able to rise. They have fallen under my feet.
For You have girded (wrapped) me with strength for the battle. You have subdued (brought down) under me those who rose up against me.

They cried, but there was no one to save them. They cried even to the LORD, but He did not answer them.
Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out like the dirt in the streets.
You have delivered (rescued) me from the strivings (fighting) of the people. You have made me the head of the heathen (people who are not Jews). A people whom I have not known will serve me.

The strangers will fade away, and be afraid out of their close places (hiding places).
The LORD lives. Blessed be my rock. Let the God of my salvation be exalted (lifted up).
It is God who avenges (pays back for) me, and subdues (brings down) the people under me.
He delivers (rescues) me from my enemies. Yes, You lift me up above those who rise up against me. You have delivered (rescued) me from the violent man.
So I will give thanks to You, O LORD, among the heathen (people who are not Jews), and sing praises to Your name.

verses.text: The heavens declare (tell) the glory of God. The firmament (sky) shows His handiwork (what His hands have made).
Day after day utters (speaks) speech, and night after night shows knowledge.

Their line has gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them He has set a tabernacle (tent) for the sun,
Which is like a bridegroom (a man getting married) coming out of his chamber (room). It rejoices like a strong man to run a race.
Its going out is from the end of the heaven, and its circuit (path around) is to the ends of it. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
The law of the LORD is perfect, converting (turning back) the soul. The testimony (witness) of the LORD is sure, making the simple wise.
The statutes (laws) of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart. The commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening (giving light to) the eyes.
The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring (lasting) forever. The judgments of the LORD are true and righteous (right) altogether.
They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold. They are sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
Also by them Your servant is warned. In keeping them there is great reward.

Keep back Your servant also from presumptuous (proud, on-purpose) sins. Do not let them have dominion (rule) over me. Then I will be upright (honest), and I will be innocent of the great transgression (sin).

We will rejoice in your salvation. In the name of our God we will set up our banners (flags). May the LORD fulfill all your petitions (requests).
Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed (chosen one). He will hear him from His holy heaven with the saving strength of His right hand.
Some trust in chariots, and some in horses. But we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

For You prevent (go ahead of) him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of pure gold on his head.

His glory is great in Your salvation. You have laid honor and majesty (greatness) on him.
For You have made him most blessed forever. You have made him exceeding (very) glad with Your countenance (face).

verses.text: My God, my God, why have You forsaken (left) me? Why are You so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
O my God, I cry in the daytime, but You do not hear. I cry in the night season, and am not silent.
But You are holy, O You who inhabit (live in) the praises of Israel.
Our fathers trusted in You. They trusted, and You delivered (rescued) them.
They cried to You, and were delivered (rescued). They trusted in You, and were not confounded (put to shame).
But I am a worm, and no man. I am a reproach (shame) of men, and despised (looked down on) by the people.
All those who see me laugh me to scorn (laugh at me). They shoot out the lip. They shake the head, saying:
He trusted in the LORD that He would deliver (rescue) him. Let the LORD deliver him, since the LORD delighted in him.
But You are the One who took me out of the womb. You made me hope when I was on my mother's breasts.
I was cast (thrown) on You from the womb. You are my God from my mother's belly.
Do not be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
Many bulls have compassed (surrounded) me. Strong bulls of Bashan have beset (closed in on) me all around.
They gaped (opened wide) their mouths at me, like a ravening (hungry, killing) and a roaring lion.
I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted in the middle of my bowels (insides).
My strength is dried up like a potsherd (broken piece of clay pot). My tongue cleaves (sticks) to my jaws. You have brought me into the dust of death.
For dogs have compassed (surrounded) me. The assembly of the wicked have inclosed (closed in on) me. They pierced my hands and my feet.
I may tell (count) all my bones. They look and stare at me.
They part (divide) my garments (clothes) among them, and cast lots (a game of chance to decide) for my vesture (robe).
But do not be far from me, O LORD. O my strength, hurry to help me.
Deliver (rescue) my soul from the sword, my darling (my only life) from the power of the dog.
Save me from the lion's mouth. For You have heard me from the horns of the unicorns (wild oxen).
I will declare (tell) Your name to my brethren (brothers). In the middle of the congregation (gathering) I will praise You.
You who fear the LORD, praise Him. All you the seed (children) of Jacob, glorify (praise) Him. And fear Him, all you the seed (children) of Israel.
For He has not despised (looked down on) or abhorred (hated) the affliction (suffering) of the afflicted (suffering one). He has not hidden His face from him. But when he cried to Him, He heard.
My praise will be of You in the great congregation (gathering). I will pay my vows (promises) before those who fear Him.
The meek (gentle) will eat and be satisfied. Those who seek the LORD will praise Him. Your heart will live forever.
All the ends of the world will remember and turn to the LORD. All the kindreds (families) of the nations will worship before You.
For the kingdom is the LORD's. He is the governor (ruler) among the nations.
All those who are fat (rich) on earth will eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust will bow before Him. And no one can keep his own soul alive.
A seed (people) will serve Him. It will be accounted (counted) to the Lord for a generation.
They will come, and will declare (tell) His righteousness (right ways) to a people that will be born, that He has done this.

verses.text: The LORD is my shepherd. I will not want (lack anything).
He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside the still waters.
He restores (makes new) my soul. He leads me in the paths of righteousness (doing right) for His name's sake.
Yes, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil. For You are with me. Your rod and Your staff (shepherd's stick), they comfort me.
You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint (put oil on) my head with oil. My cup runs over.
Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life. And I will dwell (live) in the house of the LORD forever.

verses.text: Blessed is the one whose transgression (sin) is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
Blessed is the man to whom the LORD does not impute (count) iniquity (sin), and in whose spirit there is no guile (lying).
When I kept silence, my bones waxed old (wore out) through my roaring all day long.
For day and night Your hand was heavy on me. My moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah (pause and think).

I acknowledged (admitted) my sin to You, and I have not hidden my iniquity (sin). I said: I will confess (admit) my transgressions (sins) to the LORD. And You forgave the iniquity (sin) of my sin. Selah (pause and think).
For this every one who is godly will pray to You in a time when You may be found. Surely in the floods of great waters they will not come near to him.
You are my hiding place. You will preserve (protect) me from trouble. You will compass (surround) me with songs of deliverance (rescue). Selah (pause and think).
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you will go. I will guide you with My eye.
Do not be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding. Their mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, or they will not come near to you.
Many sorrows will come to the wicked. But mercy will compass (surround) the one who trusts in the LORD.
Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous (people right with God). Shout for joy, all you who are upright (honest) in heart.

verses.text: I said: I will take heed (be careful) to my ways, so I do not sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle (a strap that holds back), while the wicked is before me.
I was dumb (silent) with silence. I held my peace (said nothing), even from good. And my sorrow was stirred.
My heart was hot within me. While I was musing (thinking deeply), the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:
LORD, make me know my end, and the measure of my days, what it is, so I may know how frail (weak) I am.

Behold (look), You have made my days like a handbreadth (the width of a hand). My age is like nothing before You. Truly every man at his best state is altogether vanity (emptiness). Selah (pause and think).
Surely every man walks in a vain show (empty shadow). Surely they are disquieted (troubled) for nothing. He heaps up riches, and does not know who will gather them.
And now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in You.
Deliver (rescue) me from all my transgressions (sins). Do not make me the reproach (shame) of the foolish.
I was dumb (silent). I did not open my mouth, because You did it.
Remove Your stroke (blow) away from me. I am consumed (worn out) by the blow of Your hand.
When You correct man for iniquity (sin) with rebukes (strong warnings), You make his beauty consume away like a moth. Surely every man is vanity (emptiness). Selah (pause and think).
Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry. Do not hold Your peace (stay silent) at my tears. For I am a stranger with You, and a sojourner (traveler), as all my fathers were.
O spare me, so I may recover strength, before I go from here, and am no more.

verses.text: I waited patiently for the LORD. He inclined (bent down) to me, and heard my cry.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry (muddy) clay. He set my feet on a rock, and established (made firm) my goings (steps).
He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many will see it, and fear, and will trust in the LORD.
Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and does not respect the proud, or those who turn aside to lies.

Many, O LORD my God, are Your wonderful works which You have done, and Your thoughts which are toward us. They cannot be reckoned up (counted) in order to You. If I would declare (tell) and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered (counted).
Sacrifice and offering You did not desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
Then I said: Lo (look), I come. In the volume (scroll) of the book it is written of me:
I delight to do Your will, O my God. Yes, Your law is within my heart.
I have preached righteousness (what is right) in the great congregation (gathering). Lo (look), I have not refrained (held back) my lips, O LORD, You know.

I have not hidden Your righteousness (right ways) within my heart. I have declared (told) Your faithfulness and Your salvation. I have not concealed (hidden) Your lovingkindness (love and kindness) and Your truth from the great congregation (gathering).
Do not withhold (hold back) Your tender mercies from me, O LORD. Let Your lovingkindness (love and kindness) and Your truth continually preserve (protect) me.

For innumerable (too many to count) evils have compassed (surrounded) me. My iniquities (sins) have taken hold on me, so I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. So my heart fails me.
Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver (rescue) me. O LORD, make haste (hurry) to help me.
Let those who seek after my soul to destroy it be ashamed and confounded (confused) together. Let those who wish me evil be driven backward and put to shame.
Let those who say to me, Aha, aha, be desolate (ruined) as a reward of their shame.
Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You. Let those who love Your salvation say continually: The LORD be magnified (praised as great).
But I am poor and needy. Yet the Lord thinks about me. You are my help and my deliverer (rescuer). Do not tarry (be slow), O my God.

verses.text: My heart is inditing (pouring out) a good matter. I speak of the things which I have made about the King. My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

Gird (strap) Your sword on Your thigh, O most mighty, with Your glory and Your majesty (greatness).
In Your majesty (greatness) ride prosperously (to victory) because of truth and meekness (gentleness) and righteousness (what is right). Your right hand will teach You terrible (awesome) things.
Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the King's enemies, and by them the people fall under You.
Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The sceptre (royal rod) of Your kingdom is a right sceptre (royal rod).

All Your garments (clothes) smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia (sweet spices), out of the ivory palaces, by which they have made You glad.
Kings' daughters were among Your honorable women. At Your right hand stood the queen in gold of Ophir.
Hearken (listen), O daughter, and consider, and incline (bend) your ear. Forget also your own people, and your father's house.
So the King will greatly desire your beauty. For He is your Lord, and worship Him.

She will be brought to the King in raiment (clothes) of needlework. The virgins (young women not yet married), her companions who follow her, will be brought to You.

You break the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

Though while he lived he blessed his soul. And men will praise you when you do well for yourself.

Why do you leap, you high hills? This is the hill which God desires to dwell (live) in. Yes, the LORD will dwell (live) in it forever.
The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels. The Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

You have ascended (gone up) on high. You have led captivity captive (led the captives away as prisoners). You have received gifts for men, yes, for the rebellious also, so the LORD God might dwell (live) among them.
Blessed be the Lord, who daily loads us with benefits (good gifts), even the God of our salvation. Selah (pause and think).
He who is our God is the God of salvation. To GOD the Lord belong the issues (ways of escape) from death.
But God will wound the head of His enemies, and the hairy scalp of the one who still goes on in his trespasses (wrongs).
The Lord said: I will bring again from Bashan. I will bring My people again from the depths of the sea,
So that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your enemies, and the tongue of your dogs in the same.
They have seen Your goings, O God, even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary (holy place).
The singers went before. The players on instruments followed after. Among them were the damsels (young women) playing with timbrels (tambourines).
Bless God in the congregations (gatherings), even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, O God, what You have wrought (done) for us.
Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring presents to You.

Rebuke (scold) the company of spearmen, the multitude (crowd) of the bulls, with the calves of the people, until every one submits himself with pieces of silver. Scatter the people who delight in war.
Princes will come out of Egypt. Ethiopia will soon stretch out her hands to God.
Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth. O sing praises to the Lord. Selah (pause and think).
To Him who rides on the heavens of heavens, which were from long ago. Lo (look), He sends out His voice, and that a mighty voice.
Ascribe (give) strength to God. His excellency (greatness) is over Israel, and His strength is in the clouds.
O God, You are terrible (awesome) out of Your holy places. The God of Israel is He who gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God.

verses.text: Save me, O God, for the waters have come in to my soul.
I sink in deep mire (mud), where there is no standing. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
I am weary (tired) of my crying. My throat is dried. My eyes fail while I wait for my God.
Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who would destroy me, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. Then I restored (paid back) what I did not take away.
O God, You know my foolishness. My sins are not hidden from You.
Do not let those who wait on You, O Lord GOD of hosts (the Lord GOD of all armies), be ashamed for my sake. Do not let those who seek You be confounded (put to shame) for my sake, O God of Israel.
Because for Your sake I have borne (carried) reproach (shame). Shame has covered my face.
I have become a stranger to my brethren (brothers), and an alien (foreigner) to my mother's children.
For the zeal (burning love) for Your house has eaten me up. The reproaches (insults) of those who reproached (insulted) You have fallen on me.
When I wept, and chastened (humbled) my soul with fasting (going without food), that was to my reproach (shame).
I also made sackcloth (rough cloth worn when sorry) my garment (clothing). And I became a proverb (byword) to them.
Those who sit in the gate speak against me. I was the song of the drunkards.
But as for me, my prayer is to You, O LORD, in an acceptable time. O God, in the multitude (greatness) of Your mercy hear me, in the truth of Your salvation.
Deliver (rescue) me out of the mire (mud), and do not let me sink. Let me be delivered (rescued) from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
Do not let the waterflood overflow me. Do not let the deep swallow me up. Do not let the pit shut her mouth on me.
Hear me, O LORD, for Your lovingkindness (love and kindness) is good. Turn to me by the multitude (greatness) of Your tender mercies.
Do not hide Your face from Your servant, for I am in trouble. Hear me speedily (quickly).
Draw near to my soul, and redeem (buy back and set free) it. Deliver (rescue) me because of my enemies.
You have known my reproach (shame), and my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries (enemies) are all before You.
Reproach (shame) has broken my heart. I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none, and for comforters, but I found none.
They also gave me gall (bitter liquid) for my meat (food). And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
Let their table become a snare (trap) before them. And what should have been for their welfare (good), let it become a trap.
Let their eyes be darkened, so they do not see. Make their loins (backs) shake continually.
Pour out Your indignation (anger) on them. Let Your wrathful (furious) anger take hold of them.
Let their habitation (home) be desolate (empty and ruined). Let no one dwell (live) in their tents.
For they persecute (attack) the one whom You have smitten (struck). They talk to the grief of those whom You have wounded.
Add iniquity (sin) to their iniquity (sin). Do not let them come into Your righteousness (right ways).
Let them be blotted out (wiped away) of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous (people right with God).
But I am poor and sorrowful. Let Your salvation, O God, set me up on high.
I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify (praise as great) Him with thanksgiving.
This also will please the LORD better than an ox or bullock (young bull) that has horns and hoofs.
The humble will see this, and be glad. And your heart will live, you who seek God.
For the LORD hears the poor, and does not despise (look down on) His prisoners.
Let the heaven and earth praise Him, the seas, and every thing that moves in them.
For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah, so they may dwell (live) there, and have it in possession (own it).
The seed (children) of His servants also will inherit (receive) it. And those who love His name will dwell (live) in it.

verses.text: In You, O LORD, I put my trust. Let me never be put to confusion (shame).
Deliver (rescue) me in Your righteousness (right ways), and cause me to escape. Incline (bend) Your ear to me, and save me.

Deliver (rescue) me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous (wrong) and cruel man.
For You are my hope, O Lord GOD. You are my trust from my youth.
By You I have been held up from the womb. You are the One who took me out of my mother's bowels (womb). My praise will be continually of You.
I am like a wonder (strange sight) to many. But You are my strong refuge (safe place).

Saying: God has forsaken (left) him. Persecute (chase) and take him, for there is no one to deliver (rescue) him.

I will also praise You with the psaltery (stringed instrument), even Your truth, O my God. I will sing to You with the harp, O You Holy One of Israel.

verses.text: Truly God is good to Israel, even to those who are of a clean heart.
But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had well nigh (very nearly) slipped.
For I was envious (jealous) of the foolish, when I saw the prosperity (success) of the wicked.
For there are no bands (pains) in their death. Their strength is firm.
They are not in trouble like other men. They are not plagued (struck with troubles) like other men.
So pride compasses (surrounds) them like a chain. Violence covers them like a garment (clothing).
Their eyes stand out with fatness. They have more than heart could wish.
They are corrupt (rotten), and speak wickedly about oppression (crushing others). They speak loftily (proudly).
They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walks through the earth.
So his people return here, and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
And they say: How does God know? Is there knowledge in the most High?
Behold (look), these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world. They increase in riches.
Truly I have cleansed (washed) my heart in vain (for nothing), and washed my hands in innocency (innocence).
For all day long I have been plagued (struck with troubles), and chastened (corrected) every morning.
If I say, I will speak like this, behold (look), I would offend against the generation of Your children.
When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me,
Until I went into the sanctuary (holy place) of God. Then I understood their end.
Surely You set them in slippery places. You cast them down into destruction.
How they are brought into desolation (ruin), as in a moment! They are utterly consumed (destroyed) with terrors.
Like a dream when one awakes, so, O Lord, when You awake, You will despise (look down on) their image.
So my heart was grieved, and I was pricked (stabbed) in my reins (deepest feelings).
I was so foolish and ignorant. I was like a beast before You.
Nevertheless I am continually with You. You have held me by my right hand.
You will guide me with Your counsel (advice), and afterward receive me to glory.
Whom do I have in heaven but You? And there is no one on earth that I desire besides You.
My flesh (body) and my heart fail. But God is the strength of my heart, and my portion (share) forever.
For lo (look), those who are far from You will perish (be destroyed). You have destroyed all those who go a whoring (are unfaithful) from You.
But it is good for me to draw near to God. I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, so I may declare (tell) all Your works.

verses.text: O God, why have You cast us off forever? Why does Your anger smoke against the sheep of Your pasture?

Remember Your congregation (gathering), which You have purchased long ago, the rod of Your inheritance (Your own people), which You have redeemed (bought back and set free), this mount Zion, where You have dwelt (lived).
Lift up Your feet to the perpetual (never-ending) desolations (ruins), even all that the enemy has done wickedly in the sanctuary (holy place).
Your enemies roar in the middle of Your congregations (gatherings). They set up their ensigns (flags) for signs.
A man was famous because he had lifted up axes on the thick trees.
But now they break down its carved work at once with axes and hammers.
They have cast fire into Your sanctuary (holy place). They have defiled (made unclean) the dwelling place of Your name by casting it down to the ground.
They said in their hearts: Let us destroy them together. They have burned up all the synagogues (meeting places) of God in the land.
We do not see our signs. There is no more any prophet. There is no one among us who knows how long.
O God, how long will the adversary (enemy) reproach (insult)? Will the enemy blaspheme (speak against) Your name forever?
Why do You withdraw (pull back) Your hand, even Your right hand? Pluck it out of Your bosom (the fold of Your robe).
For God is my King from long ago, working salvation in the middle of the earth.
You divided the sea by Your strength. You broke the heads of the dragons in the waters.
You broke the heads of leviathan (a great sea monster) in pieces, and gave him to be meat (food) to the people living in the wilderness (desert).
You cleaved (split open) the fountain and the flood. You dried up mighty rivers.
The day is Yours. The night also is Yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
You have set all the borders of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
Remember this, O LORD, that the enemy has reproached (insulted) You, and that the foolish people have blasphemed (spoken against) Your name.
O do not deliver the soul of Your turtledove to the multitude (crowd) of the wicked. Do not forget the congregation (gathering) of Your poor forever.
Have respect to the covenant (agreement). For the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations (homes) of cruelty.
O do not let the oppressed (crushed) return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise Your name.
Arise, O God, plead (argue) Your own cause. Remember how the foolish man reproaches (insults) You daily.
Do not forget the voice of Your enemies. The tumult (uproar) of those who rise up against You increases continually.

verses.text: To You, O God, we give thanks. To You we give thanks. For Your wondrous (wonderful) works declare (tell) that Your name is near.

For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red. It is full of mixture (mixed spices), and He pours out of it. But all the wicked of the earth will wring out its dregs (the bitter bottom), and drink them.

verses.text: In Judah God is known. His name is great in Israel.
In Salem also is His tabernacle (tent), and His dwelling place in Zion.
There He broke the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah (pause and think).

At Your rebuke (strong command), O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
You, even You, are to be feared. Who may stand in Your sight once You are angry?

When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek (gentle) of the earth. Selah (pause and think).

verses.text: I cried to God with my voice, even to God with my voice. And He gave ear to me.
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My sore (wound) ran in the night, and did not stop. My soul refused to be comforted.

You hold my eyes waking (keep me awake). I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
I call to remembrance my song in the night. I commune (talk) with my own heart, and my spirit made diligent (careful) search.
Will the Lord cast off forever? Will He be favorable (kind) no more?
Is His mercy clean gone forever? Does His promise fail forevermore?

And I said: This is my infirmity (weakness). But I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
I will remember the works of the LORD. Surely I will remember Your wonders of old.
I will also meditate (think deeply) on all Your work, and talk of Your doings.
Your way, O God, is in the sanctuary (holy place). Who is so great a God as our God?
You are the God who does wonders. You have declared (shown) Your strength among the people.
With Your arm You have redeemed (bought back and set free) Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah (pause and think).
The waters saw You, O God. The waters saw You. They were afraid. The depths also were troubled.
The clouds poured out water. The skies sent out a sound. Your arrows also went out everywhere.

verses.text: Give ear, O my people, to my law. Incline (bend) your ears to the words of my mouth.
I will open my mouth in a parable (a story that teaches a lesson). I will utter (speak) dark sayings (riddles) of old,
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
We will not hide them from their children. We will show to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and His strength, and His wonderful works that He has done.
For He established a testimony (witness) in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children,
So the generation to come might know them, even the children who would be born, who would arise and declare (tell) them to their children,
So they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep His commandments,
And might not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that did not set their heart right, and whose spirit was not steadfast (faithful) with God.
The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
They did not keep the covenant (agreement) of God, and refused to walk in His law,
And forgot His works, and His wonders that He had shown them.
He did marvelous (wonderful) things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand like a heap.
In the daytime also He led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
He split the rocks in the wilderness (desert), and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
And they sinned yet more against Him by provoking (angering) the most High in the wilderness (desert).
They tempted (tested) God in their heart by asking meat (food) for their lust (wrong desire).
Yes, they spoke against God. They said: Can God furnish (set) a table in the wilderness (desert)?
Behold (look), He struck the rock, so the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed. Can He give bread also? Can He provide flesh (meat) for His people?
So the LORD heard this, and was wroth (very angry). So a fire was kindled (lit) against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel,
Because they did not believe in God, and did not trust in His salvation,
Though He had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
And had rained down manna (bread from heaven) on them to eat, and had given them of the corn (grain) of heaven.
Man ate angels' food. He sent them meat (food) to the full.
He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven. By His power He brought in the south wind.
He rained flesh (meat) also on them like dust, and feathered fowls (birds) like the sand of the sea.
He let it fall in the middle of their camp, all around their habitations (homes).
So they ate, and were well filled. For He gave them their own desire.
They were not estranged (turned away) from their lust (wrong desire). But while their meat (food) was still in their mouths,
The wrath (anger) of God came on them, and slew (killed) the fattest of them, and struck down the chosen men of Israel.
For all this they still sinned, and did not believe for His wondrous (wonderful) works.
So He consumed (used up) their days in vanity (emptiness), and their years in trouble.
When He slew (killed) them, then they sought Him. They returned and enquired (searched) early after God.
They remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer (the One who buys back and sets free).
Nevertheless they flattered (said false, sweet words to) Him with their mouth, and they lied to Him with their tongues.
For their heart was not right with Him, and they were not steadfast (faithful) in His covenant (agreement).
But He, being full of compassion (deep pity), forgave their iniquity (sin), and did not destroy them. Yes, many times He turned His anger away, and did not stir up all His wrath (anger).
For He remembered that they were only flesh, a wind that passes away, and does not come again.
How often they provoked (angered) Him in the wilderness, and grieved Him in the desert!
Yes, they turned back and tempted (tested) God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
They did not remember His hand, or the day when He delivered (rescued) them from the enemy,
How He had wrought (done) His signs in Egypt, and His wonders in the field of Zoan,
And had turned their rivers into blood, and their floods, so they could not drink.
He sent divers (many different) sorts of flies among them, which devoured (ate) them, and frogs, which destroyed them.
He also gave their increase (crops) to the caterpillar, and their labor (work) to the locust (grasshopper).
He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with frost.
He also gave up their cattle to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts (lightning).
He cast on them the fierceness of His anger, wrath (anger), and indignation (fury), and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.

verses.text: Lord, hear my prayer. Listen to my cry for help.

My life is passing away like smoke. and the bones in my body burn like fire.
My heart is sad, I am like dry, dying grass. I even forget to eat.
Because of my sadness, I am losing so much weight that my skin hangs from my bones.
I am like a desert pelican, like an owl living among old, ruined buildings.
I cannot sleep. I am like a lonely sparrow on the roof.
My enemies mock me all day. and they use my name for a curse word.
I eat ashes for my food, and when I drink something, it is full of my tears.
This is because You are angry with me. You picked me up and threw me away.
My life is like shadows that disappear in the afternoon, I am like dry and dying grass.

You will rise up and comfort Zion. The time has come for you to be kind to Zion.
Jerusalem is just a heap of stones, but we, your servants, love every stone of the city, and we feel sorry for her dust.

verses.text: My whole inner being — honor and declare the greatness of the LORD! O LORD my God — you are very great! God is dressed and wrapped in honor and overwhelming splendor!
God wraps God's own self in light like a robe! God stretched out the sky above us like someone unrolling a curtain!
God built the beams of God's own home up in the waters of heaven! God uses clouds as God's own royal chariot! God rides on the wings of the wind — moving swiftly on the wind's power!
God makes God's angels spirit-beings — invisible and swift like wind. God makes God's servants burn and move like a roaring flame of fire.
God set the earth on its foundations — locked it in place — so it can never be shaken out of position. It will not move. Ever.
At creation God covered the whole earth with the deep ocean — wrapped it like a robe. The waters stood higher than the mountains!
But when God gave the waters a direct command — the waters ran away! When God's voice of thunder spoke — the waters rushed away fast!
The waters flowed up over the mountains and down through the valleys — flowing to the exact place God had built and set aside for them.
God drew a fixed line — a boundary the waters can never cross. God said: you will not come back and cover the earth again. And the waters obey.
God sends freshwater springs bursting out into the valleys. Those springs run freely between and around the hills.
Those springs give drinking water to every wild animal in the field. Even the wild donkeys find water there and satisfy their thirst.
Along those streams the birds of the sky make their homes. The birds sit and sing among the branches near the water.
God waters the hills directly from God's own heavenly home above. The whole earth is completely full — satisfied in every way — from what God's hands have made and done.
God makes the grass grow for the cattle to eat. God makes plants grow for the people to use. God causes food to come up out of the ground for everyone.
God gives wine that makes people's hearts jump with joy! God gives oil that makes people's faces shine and glow with health! God gives bread that holds up and sustains people's hearts with strength!
The great trees that belong to the LORD are overflowing with life — full to bursting! The great cedar trees of Lebanon — which God planted with God's own hand!
There the birds build their nests; the stork’s home is in the fir trees.
God made the high mountains as a safe hiding place for wild goats. God made the rocks as a shelter and safe place for the small rock badgers.
God set the moon in its place with purpose — to mark the seasons and times. The sun knows exactly when to go down — it follows God's schedule.
God makes the darkness come — and it is night. That is when all the wild animals of the forest come out and creep around to hunt.
The young lions roar loudly while they hunt their prey. Even the lions are looking to God for their food — God provides even for them.
When the sun rises — the wild animals gather themselves back together and go lie down in their dens to rest.
Then people go out to do their work — and they keep working and laboring all the way until evening.

O LORD — how many and how varied are all the things God has made! God made every single one of them with wisdom! The whole earth is completely full of what belongs to God — God's possessions are everywhere!
Look at the great wide ocean — enormous beyond counting! It is packed full of creatures without number — small ones and great ones — crawling and swimming everywhere.
Ships sail across that ocean. And there is the great sea monster Leviathan — the enormous creature God made — playing and frolicking in the deep waters! God made it to play in God's own ocean!
Every one of these creatures waits on God and looks to God with expectation. They all depend on God to give them their food at exactly the right time.
What God gives — they gather up and eat. When God opens God's hand — every creature is filled up with good things poured out!
But when God hides God's face from them — they are thrown into sudden terror and panic. When God takes away their breath — they die. And they return to the dust they came from.
When God sends out God's own Spirit-breath — new life is created! And God makes the face of the whole earth new and fresh again.
The magnificent glory of the LORD will last forever and ever! And the LORD takes deep joy and delight in everything God has made!
God just looks at the earth — and the whole earth shakes and trembles! God just touches the mountains — and they smoke like volcanoes!
I will sing to the Lord for the rest of my life. I will sing praises to my God as long as I live.
May my meditation be pleasing to the Lord; I will rejoice in the Lord.
May sinners be destroyed from the earth; may the wicked be no more. Praise the LORD, my soul! Praise the LORD!

verses.text: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD — because the LORD is good! The LORD's faithful loyal love lasts forever!
Who is able to put into words all the powerful acts of the LORD? Who can fully show all that the LORD deserves to be praised for?
Oh how happy and honored are the people who hold on to what is right and fair — who keep doing what is right every single day — all the time.
LORD — remember me! Show me the same kindness that you show to your people. Come to me, LORD — bring me your salvation!
Let me see the goodness and blessing of the people God has chosen. Let me share in the joy of God's nation. Let me celebrate and boast with pride — together with God's own people.
We — Israel — confess: We have sinned. Just like our ancestors sinned before us — we have done wrong. We have twisted what is right. We have acted wickedly.

Israel's ancestors did not truly understand God's miracles in Egypt. They did not remember how many times God showed faithful loyal love to them. Instead they stubbornly rebelled against God — right at the Red Sea — even after all God had done for them!
But even so — God saved Israel anyway — not because Israel deserved it — but for God's own name's sake — so that God's mighty power would be known and shown to everyone.
God gave the Red Sea a direct command — and it dried up. God led Israel through the deep waters as if they were walking through a dry flat desert.
God rescued Israel from the power of Egypt — those who hated Israel. God bought Israel's freedom from the grip of their enemy.
The waters of the Red Sea completely covered Pharaoh's army. Not one Egyptian soldier survived. Every single one was gone.
After seeing all that — then Israel finally believed God's words. And Israel sang God's praise.
But Israel forgot fast. Israel did not wait for God's plan to unfold. Israel rushed ahead without God.
Israel craved and craved in the wilderness — overwhelming, out-of-control craving. And Israel dared to challenge God in the desert — testing whether God could provide.
God gave Israel exactly what Israel demanded. But at the same time God sent a wasting sickness into their inner being — their souls became dry, thin, and empty.
Israel also burned with jealousy against Moses in the camp — and against Aaron — the one set apart as holy to the LORD.
The ground opened up and swallowed Dathan alive. The earth closed over Abiram and his whole group — buried them alive.
A fire broke out and burned through the rebel group. The flame destroyed the wicked people who had led the rebellion.
While Moses was on the mountain at Horeb — Mount Sinai — Israel made a golden calf idol. They bowed down and worshipped a melted and poured metal statue.
Israel traded away their most glorious thing — the living God — and replaced God with the image of a bull that eats grass. They gave up the greatest thing for the most worthless thing.
Israel forgot the LORD God — their Rescuer — the one who had done great and mighty things in Egypt on Israel's behalf.
God had done breathtaking miracles in the land of Ham — that is Egypt — and awe-striking, overwhelming acts at the Red Sea. And Israel forgot all of it.

Because of this God said God would completely destroy Israel. But Moses — whom God had chosen — stepped in. Moses stood in the gap — like a soldier defending a broken-down wall — and turned God's burning anger away from destroying Israel.
Then Israel looked down on and rejected the beautiful land God had promised them — the Promised Land. Israel refused to believe God's word.
Instead of trusting God — Israel grumbled bitterly and secretly inside their tents. And Israel refused to listen to the voice of the LORD.
Because of this — God raised God's hand and swore an oath against Israel — promising that Israel would fall and die in the wilderness.
And God vowed to throw and scatter Israel's children — their future generations — among the nations of the world — spreading them far across every land.
Israel locked themselves together with Baal-Peor — a pagan false god — yoked to it like an animal yoked at the neck. Israel ate food sacrificed to dead, lifeless idols.
By doing these things Israel made God burn with anger. And a deadly plague burst out and spread through Israel's camp.
Then Phinehas stepped forward and took action — he carried out justice in the camp. And the plague stopped.
And God credited that act to Phinehas as righteousness — as right standing before God — and it was remembered that way for every generation after him — forever.
Israel also made God angry at the waters of Meribah — and because of Israel's rebellion — things went badly for Moses. Moses suffered because of Israel's behavior.
Because Israel crushed Moses' spirit and made him bitter inside — Moses lost control and said things with his lips that he should not have said. Israel's rebellion pushed Moses into sin.
The LORD commanded Israel to destroy the evil nations in Canaan. But the people of Israel refused to obey Him.
Instead Israel mixed themselves in with the pagan nations around them and started learning and copying the evil practices of those nations.
Israel served and worshipped the idols of those nations. The idols trapped Israel like an animal in a hidden net.
Israel sacrificed their own sons and daughters to demons. These were evil spirits behind the false gods.
Israel poured out innocent blood. They killed their own sons and daughters. They sacrificed them to the idols of Canaan. Their blood polluted the land with murder.
Israel made themselves filthy by doing all this. They were unfaithful to God, like a wife cheating on her husband. They chased after their own man-made idols and evil ways.
Because of all this, the LORD's anger burned against His own people. He was disgusted by the people He had claimed as His own.
God handed Israel over to enemy nations. Nations that hated Israel took control and ruled over them.
Israel's enemies pressed them down hard and crushed them. Israel was forced to submit under the enemies' power.
Many times He rescued Israel. But they kept stubbornly following their own plans. They refused God's way. Their twisted sin brought them crashing down.
But even after all that, He looked at their pain and suffering. He listened when they cried out.
He remembered His sacred covenant with Israel. He kept His promise. Because of His faithful, loyal love, He chose mercy instead of judgment.
He also changed the hearts of Israel's captors. He made their enemies feel compassion and pity toward them.
Rescue us, LORD our God! Bring us back together. Gather us from all the nations where we were scattered. Then we can thank Your holy name. We can shout with joy in Your praise!
Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, forever and ever! Let all the people say: Amen! Praise the LORD!
